subject: App works locally, times out on server, didn't used to

messages.author: 9acdcf5f1f1c783d
messages.subject: App works locally, times out on server, didn't used to
parts:
I've seen a couple threads that deal with the "An error has occurred. The application failed to start. The application took too long to respond."
but I don't know what to think because my app (and the data it loads once because its called outside the shinyserver(function(input, output, session){...}) ) is less than 5MB.
I've had it work on the server with a lot more it needed to load. I've never seen this error and I don't know what to think.

My app starts faster than before locally (now that I've decreased how much loading I needed) but still won't respond on the server.
Any one have this happen to them? Did I accidentally change/include something that is causing this? From the looks of it, there are fewer dependencies.


Thanks everyone!
